$comment: PROJECT TRUTH — committed on purpose. GAS-Core adr/0004: per-env identifiers of external
resources live here, where a wrong ID is caught in review once instead of on every machine.
Machine truth and secrets (clasp auth, admin secrets, API tokens, the static-host checkout
path, the deploymentId cache the deploy writes back) stay in the gitignored
GActionSheet is lineage A: ONE script project holds both named deployments (TEST-WEB-APP,
PROD-WEB-APP), told apart by an anchor in the deployment description — so 'test' and
'production' below share one scriptId and one sheetId (the single bound container
spreadsheet), unlike a lineage-B project where each env is its own script project.
envs.<target>.scriptId / .sheetId are read by gas-deploy (>= v1.4.0). local.settings.json
still carries its own copies of scriptId/testSheetId too — tests/conftest.py's script_id
fixture and tests/playwright/editor_helpers.js read local.settings.json directly, not through
gas-deploy's loader, so the legacy keys stay live rather than becoming a second silent drift.
Pointed out at this conversion (GAS-Core-rgh); folding those two readers onto this file too is
left for the estate-wide key-convergence pass, not this stage.
envs.<target>.static and staticHosts are read by this project's scripts/static-pages.js, which
composes gas-static's config from them; gas-deploy ignores them.
